name: ANATHEMIC BEAT
source:
this will be the first time in many years that you won't be here for the festival. the bonfire and food stalls. the comfortable monotony shattered by a perfect replica of old world fireworks. but this is more important than any of that. 
this is the lighthouse.

in ANATHEMIC BEAT, play as syretia of the columbines, a library clerk with a white hot obsession with a world left in ruin. as the final bastion of the old age, will the lighthouse be her altar or her grave?

[From [url=https://happycat-games.itch.io/anathemic-beat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这将是多年来你第一次不来参加这个节日。篝火和小吃摊。旧世界烟花的完美复制品打破了舒适的单调。但这比任何一个都更重要。
这是灯塔。

在《ANATHEMIC BEAT》中，扮演哥伦拜恩的塞雷蒂亚（syretia），一名图书馆职员，对这个被毁坏的世界怀有一种白热化的痴迷。作为晚年最后的堡垒，灯塔会是她的祭坛还是她的坟墓？

[来自[url=https://happycat-games.itch.io/anathemic-beat]Itch.io[/url]]
